verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Gitea issues with branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates and dependencies. Nothing in it describes linking commits or pull requests to issues, or keyword-based automatic issue status changes from commit messages. This is a fair axis for a Git hosting product, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link commits and pull requests to issues and have issue status update automatically from commit messages
